title: Viva Engage: new post creation experience
summary: The briefing passes: the default-on redesign, licensing background and absence of a documented layout switch are supported. The changed setup and storyline pages do not contradict it, and all five previously throttled Learn pages opened successfully. Minor corrections should distinguish the announced rollout schedule from confirmed delivery and cite the community-visibility source.
